authority_clamp.fact: Endpoint LOW holds both physical latch clears LOW; motion/output request LOW also blocks final permission gates. No useful-progress/rearm/clear pulse is generated.

motor_idle.fact: Noninverting LVC244 STEP/DIR/EN_N path; EN_N default pull-up, all12 HIGH inactive. Existing current runtime uses enable_n=~gen_enable.

process.fact: PWM/PEN AND gated with physical permission, FPGA inputs default LOW.

port_power.fact: LOW request/default keeps frontend/accessory protected port switches OFF.

shift_idle.fact: Clock LOW pulldown; load_n HIGH pullup. Reader unimplemented in this bounded wrapper.

common_controls.fact: OPI motor rearm and active-HIGH watchdog clear have LOW common-stem defaults; no strobe emitted. OUT independent rearm held LOW.

arm_lamp.fact: ISO7720F command path default LOW. Lamp request remains LOW.

fault_test_pins.fact: Bare diagnostic test points only, no field/motion authority. Historical cnc_motherboard_motion_bringup defines active-HIGH faults; four asserted pins explicitly identify unqualified diagnostic image.

SPI.fact: Existing mode0 masters reset CS high, SCLK/MOSI low. Host MISO raw reset/CS-dependent OE retained, inferred top tri-state requires later vendor IO implementation review.
